_comment: Real PostgreSQL regression coverage for connection ownership (Python issue145). Threads, Fibers/coroutines and independent async contexts use their native execution identity. No mocks. Full suites and final shipping-head verification are recorded in the release plan.

invariants.rule: An ordinary operation in another execution context cannot observe uncommitted rows or have its successful write removed by rollback of a different context. The active transaction exclusively owns its connection until completed.
cases: pool transaction lease prevents cross context dirty reads and lost writes

invariants.rule: If all pool connections are leased, a competing operation fails clearly rather than using an in-use connection. Pool exhaustion does not abort, commit, or roll back the existing owner transaction.
cases: pool exhaustion fails without sharing a live transaction

invariants.rule: A failed transaction commit retains the owner connection until rollback. Terminal rollback releases the lease; a broken driver is discarded and later operations can reconnect.
cases: pool failed commit retains lease until rollback
